products.title: Mount Dominance by Brandon McCaghren
products.body:
Develop a More Dominant Mount and Learn The “Musts” of The No Gi Top Game Featuring 10th Planet Black Belt Instructor, Brandon McCaghren

  • Take an unorthodox approach to some classic jiu-jitsu themes, and revolutionize the way you attack from one of BJJ’s most underutilized positions, all with a 10th Planet Black Belt at the helm
  • The mount is an entirely different animal in no gi and we must adapt our games to reflect these major differences so we can still dominate from this important position
  • Learn superior body positioning tactics that you’ve never seen before so you can transform your no gi mount game from average to extraordinary

products.title: The Ultimate Rubber Guard by Eddie Bravo
products.body:
Learn The Ultimate Rubber Guard System - In It’s Newest Updated Form From Its Inventor, The Most Unique Thinker in Grappling, Eddie Bravo

  • The rubber guard, a closed guard variation that helps protect you better in MMA or self defense, is so powerful that Eddie and his students have used it in elite Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and MMA competitions.
  • Eddie combines these concepts with his half guard series, where often in competition he would use lockdowns, electric chairs, and meathooks for incredible sweeps and submissions against bigger, stronger, way more experienced fighters.
  • Eddie digs deep and shows all the little hacks and set ups that make rubber guard a serious threat for anyone who has the system down.



Learn The Ultimate Rubber Guard System - In It’s Newest Updated Form From Its Inventor, The Most Unique Thinker in Grappling, Eddie Bravo
Attack From Rubber Guard And The Lockdown As Eddie Bravo Gives A Technique Breakdown And History Lesson Into How ANYONE Can Use Jiu-Jitsu’s Most Controversial Guard


What Will You Learn?

Master one of the most notorious and mysterious grappling styles on the planet, as the founder of 10th Planet Jiu-Jitsu and inventor of the rubber guard Eddie Bravo explains the method behind his madness in this new blockbuster BJJ Fanatics release. Learn with Eddie as he explains each move in his signature rubber guard system, showing not just how to do each move but also telling the story behind each position’s creation and why he does things his own unique way.

The rubber guard is one of the most discussed positions in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, but you can stop all the rumors and hear from the creator himself as he tells you the real history of the move and why it is so effective when done right. The rubber guard, a closed guard variation that helps protect you better in MMA or self defense, is so powerful that Eddie and his students have used it in elite Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and MMA competitions.

Eddie combines these concepts with his half guard series, where often in competition he would use lockdowns, electric chairs, and meathooks for incredible sweeps and submissions against bigger, stronger, way more experienced fighters. Now these techniques can be yours as Eddie gives you the same instruction he gives his students at 10th Planet, in this exciting new partnership with BJJ Fanatics.

Eddie Bravo isn’t the only one having success with his infamous style of guard. His students are competing at the highest levels in grappling and MMA, including ADCC veterans, no gi world champions, and 10th Planet black belt and former UFC Interim Champion Tony Ferguson (who won the title with a triangle from guard). In fact, the 10th Planet team regularly dominates the Quintet team tournaments and Combat Jiu-Jitsu events using their submission-oriented style.

Even though Eddie’s rubber guard is known for being used by flexible fighters, he’s got dozens of gyms and thousands of students who all use this same style for success, including average men and women with average flexibility. So how are they playing this kind of guard game? Eddie explains how, showing the little hacks and set ups that make rubber guard a serious threat for anyone who has the system down. 

Get the famous names of all of 10th Planet’s unique positions, with Eddie explaining the origin of each name so you can understand and remember better. Fight from the famous mission control, use the chill dog, dead orchard, and double bagger, and wrap people up in the cocoon as Eddie shifts from move to move systematically. Don’t get confused by the names Eddie’s athletes use, instead turn those to your advantage by tapping into this new source of knowledge, spread over four volumes.

These four volumes help you really get into one of the most creative minds in grappling, as he gives you full access into his gym, his techniques, his system, and his reasons for doing what he does. Go far beyond your limits and visit the 10th Planet with all of Eddie’s battle tested systems, shown with more detail than ever before on BJJ Fanatics. No crazy flexibility, no super strength, just safe and effective grappling that Eddie’s students use for huge success.

What Exactly Do You Get?

Part 1:

  • Origin of Combat Jiu Jitsu
  • History of Jiu Jitsu in MMA
  • Gi vs No Gi Debate 
  • Origin of Rubber Guard 
  • Rubber Guard to Omoplata 

Part 2:

  • Evolution of the Rubber Guard

Part 3:

  • Full Rubber Guard

Part 4:

  • Bottom Half
  • Rubber Guard Variations

So What Does It Cost?

products.title: Hurricane Heather's Half Guard Havoc: 10th Planet Top Game Unleashed by Heather Jo Clark
products.body:
Dive into the groundbreaking world of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu with Heather Jo Clark's comprehensive instructional, the 10th Planet Top Game. Crafted within the innovative framework developed by the legendary Eddie Bravo!

  • Learn the unique and effective approach of 10th planet BJJ - Heather is extremely articulate and makes it easy to learn
  • Become dangerous from top and catch your opponents and training partners off guard
  •  Cutting-edge concepts: Explore the latest advancements in the 10th Planet system, including unique grips, angles, and transitions, revolutionizing your approach to top control
  • With Heather Jo Clark's 10th Planet Top Game, you'll harness the power of Eddie Bravo's revolutionary system to dominate your opponents and become a force to be reckoned with on the mats


Check Out a Free Sample:

What Will You Learn?

"Unlock the Ultimate Top Game Mastery with Heather Jo Clark's 10th Planet System!

Dive into the groundbreaking world of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu with Heather Jo Clark's comprehensive instructional, the 10th Planet Top Game. Crafted within the innovative framework developed by the legendary Eddie Bravo, this guide unveils the secrets to dominating from the top position like never before.

Inside, you'll discover a dynamic array of techniques, strategies, and insights meticulously designed to elevate your game to new heights. Whether you're a seasoned practitioner or just beginning your journey in BJJ, Clark's expert guidance provides a roadmap to success, offering:

  • Step-by-step breakdowns: Master each technique with clear, concise instructions accompanied by detailed demonstrations, ensuring seamless execution on the mats.
  • Cutting-edge concepts: Explore the latest advancements in the 10th Planet system, including unique grips, angles, and transitions, revolutionizing your approach to top control.
  • Tactical brilliance: Learn how to anticipate your opponent's movements, exploit weaknesses, and maintain dominant positions with strategic precision, turning defense into offense effortlessly.

With Heather Jo Clark's 10th Planet Top Game, you'll harness the power of Eddie Bravo's revolutionary system to dominate your opponents and become a force to be reckoned with on the mats. Transform your BJJ game and unleash your full potential today!"

Who is this for?

This instructional is perfect for anyone that wants to learn a unique and effective top game that is not as traditional as other approached. 10th Planet has had success at the highest levels and this can be partially attributed to the uniqueness of their attacks, catch your opponent off guard.
